source: docs/VALUE_AT_RISK.md section 6 (published rows) + labelled project assumptions
note: Quotable cost references for the custom-valuation layer. `basis` is 'published' when the figure comes from a cited external table and 'assumed' when it is this project's own placeholder; an assumed statement carries the [assumed] marker inside the text, so the caveat travels with the quote the agent makes. Nothing here is a valuation of any particular building. A record carrying `components` with `amount_eur_low`/`amount_eur_high` is a worked example: the offline FakeLLM stand-in replays it verbatim so its demo proposal states no number that is not in a tool result. The live model composes its own.

references.title: Worked example, research campus whose value is its equipment [assumed]
references.statement: [assumed] Worked example for a research campus whose value is its equipment rather than its floor area: compute and storage installation 24000000 EUR, laboratory fit-out and specialised stores 18000000 EUR, building shell and services 8000000 EUR, giving 50000000 EUR as the mid figure with a plausible range of 30000000 to 80000000 EUR. The shell is the smallest of the three, which is the whole reason a per-square-metre table cannot price this class. This is a project placeholder for demonstration, not a valuation of any particular campus.

references.title: ATC 2025 replacement cost, teaching buildings
references.statement: Agencia Tributaria de Catalunya, Valors basics dels immobles urbans 2025, class Docent: 600 - 1000 - 1500 EUR per m2 built, for very modest - average - very good quality.
references.source: Agencia Tributaria de Catalunya, Valors basics dels immobles urbans 2025

references.title: ATC 2025 replacement cost, health buildings
references.statement: Agencia Tributaria de Catalunya, Valors basics dels immobles urbans 2025, class Sanitari: 780 - 1300 - 1950 EUR per m2 built. Recent hospital tenders run 2200 - 2400 EUR per m2 for construction only.
references.source: Agencia Tributaria de Catalunya, Valors basics dels immobles urbans 2025

references.title: From construction cost to replacement value
references.statement: Practical rule [est.]: replacement value = built area x ATC value x 1.3 - 1.5 for fees, VAT and contents; hospitals plus 30 - 40 percent for equipment.

references.title: High-performance computing installation [assumed]
references.statement: [assumed] A high-performance computing installation is priced by its machine, not by its floor area: 400000 - 1200000 EUR per populated compute rack including interconnect and primary storage. The machine-room fit-out - power distribution, cooling, fire suppression - typically costs as much again as the shell that houses it. This is a project placeholder, not a quotation for any particular installation.

references.title: Laboratory fit-out above shell cost [assumed]
references.statement: [assumed] Laboratory and controlled-environment fit-out runs 1500 - 3500 EUR per m2 above the shell cost, and specialised stores - biobanks, sample freezers, animal facilities - are not replaceable at any fit-out price. This is a project placeholder, not a quotation.

references.title: Rebuild time for a specialised facility [assumed]
references.statement: [assumed] A specialised facility takes 24 - 48 months to design, rebuild and recommission, during which its service is delivered elsewhere or not at all. Continuity cost is the annual operating budget times that outage, not the cost of the building. This is a project placeholder.

references.title: IRTA institutional scale
references.statement: IRTA is a research institute of the Generalitat de Catalunya with about 1000 staff across some 10 sites; the Monells centre houses food-technology and animal-science research including experimental facilities and sample collections.

references.title: Fire station replacement
references.statement: A fire station is a shed, an apparatus bay and a crew room; its worth is the appliances inside it, which drive out under their own power, and a station is rebuilt to a standard design. Losing the building degrades cover for a season, not a capability that cannot be rebuilt.
